Sections are wrapped with `…` markers (grammar: the `sdd-extract` CLI, name grammar `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`). Anchor names are normative per `AX_TICKET_SECTION_NAMES_NORMATIVE` — orchestrator (`sdd-execute`) and auditor extract by exact string (`extract PHASE_P`, `META`, `EXECUTION_LOG`, …). Each `### P` phase block under `Phases` gets its own anchor (`PHASE_P1`, `PHASE_P2`, …); the `Phases` container itself carries NO anchor — extraction is per phase.
Spec content is referenced, never copied (`AX_SSOT_TRACEABILITY`): tickets link to spec sections via Markdown anchors — module spec for contracts / consumers / invariants; scope spec Requirements & Constraints only for cross-cutting constraints.
